scope_choices: Automated model review, not independent human verification, replication or clinical validation.

This synthesis read all 18 supplied text pages, references, appendices and earlier image-review notes. Earlier API page calls received images; this synthesis did not directly receive or inspect page images.
Historical chunk-local unavailable-page statements in earlier notes do not mean the complete supplied text is currently unavailable.
Source hash, page count and page-call receipts are supplied provenance, not recomputed filesystem or billing verification.
No external repositories, model cards, weights or supplements were retrieved or executed.
No executable JSON Schema validation, reference checker, coverage counter, graph rebuild, file save or canonical admission was performed.
Common study-level assertions have an explicit seven-configuration scope contract; model-specific differences remain separately scoped. Export must preserve these qualifiers.
All seven inspected configurations lack implemented persistent-state advancement. Strict ontology not_world_model does not negate their useful WM-inspired representation contribution.
Spatial z is not clinical time. Optimization iterations, crop counts and input strides are not forecast horizons.
Latent-target invariance is only partially aligned with the predictive-latent feature; no successor mechanism is inferred from LeJEPA terminology.
Annotation-field readouts satisfy the broad emission criterion only narrowly; they do not reconstruct CT intensity or generate future observations.
The E4 positive is limited to anatomical-representation consistency tests, not clinical plausibility of generated anatomy or clinical readiness.
No-auxiliary configurations still use annotation-derived sampling; supervision-free must not be read as annotation-independent.
Scaled configuration differences do not isolate data scaling. Full pool manifest, pretraining/test overlap and preprocessing-fit exclusions remain insufficiently reported.
Table VI selected-probe, Figure 4 five-seed-mean and Table VII/Appendix G available-seed-mean summaries are different estimands.
Metric confidence intervals do not establish predictive calibration, uncertainty decomposition, equivalence or clinical acceptance.
Table I's continuity plus/minus statistic is undefined. The cosine-distance ratio can exceed one; the authors separately report a bounded Euclidean alternative.
Single-direction linear residualization does not remove every nonlinear position correlate. Effective-rank limitations remain relevant.
Organ-span targets and references both derive from TotalSegmentator. Improved smoothness accompanies worse matched-pair localization, not a demonstrated clinical benefit.
Spatial subsampling does not test every native spacing, scanner, kernel or population shift.
Classifier refitting shows target-supervised adaptability, not automatic recovery or a unique causal explanation of transfer failure.
Figure 3's 14-pixel stride, current patch-16 backbones and earlier patch-14 release require reconciliation.
Average-pooled pretraining coverage and max-pooled probing masks are reported separately; matching-target claims require clarification.

Table XIII's disputed D-0-L pulmonary fibrotic sequela cell remains 0.456 in supplied extracted text versus 0.546 in earlier supplied image-review transcription. Neither transcription is silently preferred.
Safety, privacy, ethics, calibration, human evaluation and clinical utility silence is retained as not_reported where applicable. No deployment permission or universal threshold is inferred.
Raw historical legacy metadata, quotation counts and audit claims are preserved but were not independently reproduced.
